name: Trade8
tagline: Professional trading on Sentin8 — order management, broker connectivity, synchronous pre-trade risk, market data, bar aggregation, and day P&L as one broker-side vertical.
pillarsLead: Trade8 inherits the Sentin8 security model and adds trading guarantees — synchronous risk gates on every mutation, deterministic P&L from fill replay, and adapter-pluggable market data.

pillars.title: Risk before acceptance
pillars.summary: Desk calls Risk over a direct TLS path before accepting any order mutation — buying power, exposure, and restricted symbols are checked synchronously, never after the fact.

pillars.title: One order lifecycle
pillars.summary: Desk owns submit → validate → authorize → accept → route → track → terminal; every state transition is event-sourced and auditable.

pillars.title: Deterministic P&L
pillars.summary: Pnl is a pure bus consumer: positions and day P&L rebuild deterministically from fill events and opening balances — the same fills always produce the same P&L.

pillars.title: Pluggable market data
pillars.summary: Feed ingests vendor quotes through adapters (ITCH, IDC, crypto websocket, FIX-MD, simulation) and normalizes them into one internal event shape.

pillars.title: Bars for every window
pillars.summary: Bars aggregates OHLCV at standard intervals (1s…1d) from consolidated trade prints — live intrabar snapshots and historical series from one engine.

units.name: Trade8:Desk
units.summary: The order-management core: owns the order lifecycle (submit → validate → authorize → accept → route → track → terminal) and the working-order state.

units.name: Trade8:Router
units.summary: All outbound broker connectivity: consumes routed orders from Desk, resolves the destination route (market → gateway → broker), executes, and reports fills back.

units.name: Trade8:Risk
units.summary: The synchronous, in-env pre-trade authorization gate: evaluates trader state, buying power (reserved notionals), and limits before any order mutation is accepted.

units.name: Trade8:Feed
units.summary: The market-data tier: vendor quotes through pluggable adapters (ITCH, IDC, crypto websocket, FIX-MD, simulation), normalized into one internal event shape (L1 BBO, trades, depth).

units.name: Trade8:Bars
units.summary: OHLCV bar aggregation: consumes consolidated trade prints and aggregates bars at standard intervals (1s, 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 1d) for live charting and historical series.

units.name: Trade8:Pnl
units.summary: The day profit-and-loss engine: a pure bus consumer that rebuilds positions and P&L deterministically from fill events and opening balances.

apps.name: eTrader
apps.summary: The professional trading app: order entry tickets, blotter, market data watch, positions and day P&L — through the BFF proxy like every app.

sdks.name: trade8 Rust SDK
sdks.summary: The shared vertical plane: fixed/Price-Qty math, protocol codecs, event contracts, and typed clients every trade8 service and integrator consumes.

showcaseLead: Trade8 contains no platform infrastructure of its own — identity, events, storage, scheduling, and supervision are consumed from the platform.

showcase.name: Sentin8 — the platform
showcase.summary: 17 services: identity, events, storage, workflows, scheduling — everything trade8 doesn't rebuild.

showcase.name: Exchange8
showcase.summary: The venue-side vertical — run an exchange or MTF on the same platform.
